question.text: SEBI's Market Data Advisory Committee plays a role in:

answer.text: Advising on data dissemination, transparency, and market information standards

explanation.text: The Logic: By its name and standard regulator-committee structure, a Market Data Advisory Committee plays an advisory role on data dissemination, transparency, and market information standards. Such SEBI advisory bodies provide input into policy on disclosure and dissemination of market information. The Trap: Commodity prices are determined by markets, not by a committee. Approving individual trades is not the role of any advisory committee. Exchange technology is managed by the exchange itself. Note: The NISM-Series-XVI Commodity Derivatives Certification Examination workbook (December 2025) supports exchange spot-price polling, disclosure and dissemination, plus product and regulatory oversight committees on the pages reviewed, but a specifically named "Market Data Advisory Committee" was not found in the cited pages. The reasoning above reflects general regulator advisory-committee practice rather than a direct workbook citation.
